# Pulmo Balance

> Pulmo Balance is a Respiratory & Lung Support Supplement. Pulmo Balance is a dietary supplement marketed as a natural lung and respiratory support formula. It is designed as a daily capsule-based wellness product for people who want to support their respiratory comfort and everyday breathing function through a blend of natural ingredients. It is positioned as a supplement, not a medication, and is intended to complement — not replace — healthy habits and any care plan you already follow.
